svg.title: How the code connects to the formal models, mobile layout
svg.desc: Oraclizer/formal-verification publishes Isabelle/HOL models with named assumptions, Rust source correspondence and executable exports from the checked theories. This repository publishes the specification and reference code and pins the model files by SHA-256 and Git blob. The required Tests check compares Rust, Go and the typed transport model on 692 inputs, Rust and the full response model on 261 inputs, and Rust, Go and the checked threshold signature step on 22 packets. The specification covers 33 operations at wire version 6 with single and threshold signatures. Any difference fails the check. Model and conformance evidence applies within its stated scope.
